parents.immutability: verify every manifest output hash before and after cycle3; never write into either parent run

frozen_scores.cycle1_models: load the saved outer-fold C0 C1 C4 C5 models only to reconstruct their original outer-validation scores; verify outer-test scores against saved predictions
frozen_scores.cycle2_models: use saved outer-validation and outer-test raw predictions and the alpha selected by v4 validation_selected for the same fold and scenario
frozen_scores.calendar_window: same train-only 5th-to-95th-percentile first-event day-of-year rule as cycle1
frozen_scores.periodic_controls: carry forward periodic_30d and every fixed k17 phase from v4 without external phase selection
frozen_scores.c6_missing_weather: retain exact C0 score fallback and one continuous notification state
frozen_scores.c4_c5_missing_weather: retain abstention; do not add fallback

evaluation_scopes.service_calendar: all service-active field-days in continuous calendar order; C6_weather falls back to C0 where its weather correction is unavailable
evaluation_scopes.paired_candidate_days: exact cycle1 candidate_comparison_complete mask; dates outside the mask remain elapsed calendar time and never compress cooldown

notification_policy.growth_reference: score stored at the last actually issued message of the same system
notification_policy.state_update: every real ordinary or growth message updates last date score origin model version and comparison segment and restarts cooldown and alarm
notification_policy.alarm_semantics: message date plus six following dates inclusive; alarm_active does not itself block a message

score_comparability.source_transition: starts a new comparability segment but does not reset last message cooldown alarm or burden
score_comparability.missing_score: starts a new comparability segment when a valid score later resumes; no future interpolation
score_comparability.c6_weather_alpha_zero: effective origin is C0 on every day regardless of unused weather availability
score_comparability.c6_weather_positive_alpha: effective origin is C6_weather when correction is available and C0_fallback otherwise

coverage_reporting.correction_unavailable: raw frozen weather-correction availability diagnostic, regardless of whether alpha makes the correction active
coverage_reporting.fallback_to_c0: actual use of C0 in place of an active positive-alpha C6 correction; always false when alpha is zero
coverage_reporting.effective_c0_origin: days whose policy score effectively comes from C0, including all alpha-zero C6 days and positive-alpha fallback days
coverage_reporting.rule: report these quantities separately and never call raw correction unavailability an operational fallback when alpha is zero

policy_families.P0_saved: exact saved theta with cooldown 15 and growth disabled
policy_families.P0_selected: growth disabled; theta selected on the same validation scores and same theta grid as all cycle3 candidates
policy_families.P_growth_selected: select theta and one of the fixed growth delta choices including disabled on outer-validation only
policy_families.P_short_selected: growth disabled; cooldown fixed to 7 days; theta selected on the same outer-validation scores and theta grid

selection.population: the actual outer-validation years of each frozen outer fold
selection.theta_grid: fixed 0.05 through 0.95 by 0.05 plus 1.000001 plus 5th through 95th validation score quantiles by 0.05 plus the saved theta; constructed only from service-active days in the current scope

population_audit.eligible_definition: warnable_first_event_true in the same A_plus_B outer-test population used by timely recall
population_audit.entry_positive_definition: first registered positive is already known when the service enters

uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive across six already studied years; does not include model selection registration timing or overlapping training uncertainty
